QT6HR2642231:
Listen up. This ain't no history book fairy tale
This is the raw, uncut slaughter at Ruby Ridge
Where the feds turned a hillbilly with a bad court date into public enemy number one
And painted the Idaho mountains red with Weaver blood

Randy Weaver
Just a man who wanted to be left the fuck alone on his 20-acre slice of nowhere
No electricity, no running water. Raising his kids off-grid with his wife, Vicky
They had their beliefs. Weird ones, sure. But last time I checked

Thinkin' the world's ending, don't give the government a license to play judge, jury, and executioner with 308 rounds
First they send in the ATF with their snitch games
Sell us some illegal shotgun barrels, Randy. Classic entrapment hustle
Weaver bites once, they slap him with a bullshit warrant

Then they fuck up the court date on purpose. Or accidentally. Depending on which liar you believe
And when he don't show, boom! Full fugitive status
U.S. Marshals roll up like it's the goddamn invasion of Normandy
Six deep, armed to the teeth, crawlin' through the woods like cockroaches in tactical gear

August 21, 1992. The family dog, Stryker, does what any loyal dog does, barks at the intruders
So these federal heroes light the dog up first, Sammy Weaver, 14 years old, sees his dog murdered and opens fire
Next thing you know, Deputy Marshal Bill Dagan is dead, Sammy shot in the back while runnin' for his life, and Kevin Harris is bleeding out
One kid, one dog, one fed, all in the first five minutes of law enforcement

Day two, the FBI hostage rescue team rolls in like they're storming Baghdad
They write themselves brand new rules of engagement on the spot
Basically a shoot-on sight pass for any armed adult male. No negotiation, no surrender
Just, if they got a gun, light him up. That ain't policy. That's a hunting license with a government stamp

Sniper Lon Horiyuchi sets up 200 yards out. Randy steps out toward the shed where his dead son is lying
First shot rips through Randy's arm, then Vicky Weaver, unarmed, holding her Ten-month-old baby, a LeShiba, in the cabin doorway
Steps into view for half a second, Horiyuchi pulls the trigger again
The bullet goes through the door, blows Vicky's head apart, and shreds Kevin Harris, too

A mother holding her infant executed in her own home. The baby was covered in her mother's brains
And the feds? They left Vicky's body rotting in the doorway for days while they kept the siege going
No apology. No oops. Just more lies, more spin, more we feared for our lives while they had night vision helicopters and enough firepower to level a city block
A trial? A goddamn joke jury looked at the evidence and basically said

Y'all federal boys murdered a kid and a mom over two shotgun barrels and a missed court date
Weaver and Harris walked on the heavy charges. Government had to cough up 3.1 million in hush money to the family. Blood money, not justice
This wasn't law enforcement. This was a government death squad playing cowboy on American soil
They shot the dog for barking. They shot the kid in the back. They headshot a mother holding a baby

Then they spent years covering their asses, destroying reports, and giving each other pats on the back
Ruby Ridge wasn't a tragedy. It was a slaughter. A cold-blooded flex by the same machine that would go on to Waco
And then wonder why the whole country started looking at federal badges like they were gang colors
They didn't come for Randy Weaver because he was dangerous. They came because he told them no

And when the feds hear no, they don't send lawyers. They send snipers
Rest in power to Sammy and Vicky. The rest of those federal clowns can rot in the hell they earned
